the pre-annealing of Cu-Cr alloy source/drain (SD) electrodes on a-IGZOTFT can enhance the performance.
the Cu-Cr alloy electrode can be used for a-IGZO-TFTs and that the pre-annealing process can be used to prevent Cu diffusion and increase the mobility of a-IGZOTFTs.
a-IGZO is a promising candidate for high performance thin film transistors with Cu-Cr alloy electrodes.

the development of Cu-Cr alloy source/drain electrode for a-IGZO based thin film transistor.
the effect of post treatment on a-IGZOTFTs with a Cu-Cr alloy source/drain electrode.
the development of a-IGZOTFTs with high performance using Cu-Cr source/drain electrodes.

the pre-annealing of the a-IGZO channel layer before sputtering Cu-Cr alloy electrodes improves the device performance.
the Cu-Cr source/drain electrodes with post-treatment can effectively improve the electrical characteristics of the a-IGZO-TFT.
the Cu-Cr alloy source/drain electrode is an effective solution for a-IGZO based TFTs with a low turn-on voltage.

a-IGZO/Cu-Cr alloy electrode TFTs are promising for future flexible displays and organic light-emitting diode (OLED) applications.
the post treatment of Cu-Cr alloy source/drain electrode can effectively reduce the Cu diffusion and improve the electrical properties of a-IGZOTFTs.
the pre-annealing and Cr doping of a-IGzo can be used to achieve high performance TFTs with Cu-Cr electrodes.

the Cu-Cr alloy source/drain electrode can be applied to the a-IGZO-TFTs to enhance device performance.
the use of the Cu-Cr alloy source/drain electrode is a promising way to achieve low-resistance, high-mobility a-IGZO-based TFTs.
